issues: Spec says 'le bouton Enregistrer (qc-opening-save) reste actif mais l'API refuse si non équilibré' — actual behaviour is stricter: the button is DISABLED via `disabled={saving || !balanced}` when the totals are not balanced. This is safer UX but does not match spec text. Consider re-enabling the button to show the 400 error toast as documented (or update the spec).

Hydration warning in console: '<span> cannot be a child of <option>' — comes from the instrumentation wrapper injecting <span> inside <option> in LineItemsEditor account <select>. Cosmetic warning only, does not break functionality but pollutes DevTools.
Legacy from previous iterations: native browser date pickers still used for Date/Échéance instead of shadcn Calendar component. Not a blocker.

action_items: Minor: decide whether qc-opening-save should stay ENABLED-when-unbalanced (matches request text) or DISABLED-when-unbalanced (current, safer). Current behaviour is functionally correct — API still rejects a bad payload with the exact FR 400 message.

Minor: silence the <span> in <option> hydration warning by rendering the option label as a plain string (e.g. ``{`${a.gl} · ${a.description}`}``) instead of using JSX expressions that get wrapped by the instrumentation tooling.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py now 6223 lines — the qc9434 block (>2000 lines including opening, invoices/bills multi-lignes, AI extract, cashflow, payments, reminders) really should be extracted to backend/qc9434.py. Flagged repeatedly.

qc_bill_extract calls GPT-5.4 vision with the FULL list of charge accounts in the system prompt — for a company with many charge GLs the prompt size will grow unbounded. Consider capping to top-N most-used charge accounts or grouping by section to keep the prompt small and improve accuracy.

qc_bill_extract silently coerces an unknown GL to default_expense when the LLM hallucinates a code — good defensive behaviour, but the frontend has no way to know this happened. Add a per-item flag 'account_fallback: true' in the response so the UI can highlight rows the user should review.

qc_put_opening does not validate that submitted GLs actually exist in qc9434_accounts — a typo would silently create/target a non-existent GL via _qc_post_opening. Add `if gl not in valid_gls: continue` (or 400).

InvoicesView.save/BillsView.save do not disable the dialog while saving (only the Save button) — a fast double-click on other action buttons could trigger duplicate saves in rare cases. Consider blocking the whole dialog while saving=true.

The AI extract endpoint uses 'gpt-5.4' — please confirm this is a supported model in emergentintegrations (the previous phase used gpt-4o / gpt-4o-mini). If not stabilised, add a fallback to gpt-4o on 502.

context_for_next_testing_agent: test_qc9434_phase6.py is idempotent: needs REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL exported; run with `python -m pytest backend/tests/test_qc9434_phase6.py -o addopts='' -v` because /app/backend/pytest.ini enables xdist and phase 6 uses module-scoped globals _INV_ID/_BILL_ID that require single-worker (loadfile mode). The AI extract test can occasionally 502 if the LLM key is rate-limited — the test does pytest.skip() in that case. 2026 must remain OPEN (unlocked).
